NONE for either cutover. No broker page, PDF or notice I retrieved names the SGX circular that effected (A) the 04:45->05:15 T+1 close or (B) the 2024 Japan T-session extension. Every broker relays SGX without an identifier: HGNH says only "根据新交所通知" ("according to SGX's notice"), Rakuten says only "SGX（シンガポール取引所）の取引時間延長に伴い", Phillip Futures says only "the Singapore Exchange will be extending its T+1 session close", Phillip Nova says only "Please visit JPX and SGX websites for more information".

WHAT I DID ESTABLISH — the retrievable identifier scheme and two member firms that mirror SGX circulars verbatim. This is a live, currently-downloadable verbatim SGX circular hosted by an SGX member (KGI Securities Singapore), on SGX letterhead, footer "Singapore Exchange Derivatives Trading Limited / Company Reg No. 197802854W":
https://www.kgieworld.sg/futures/resources/ck/files/docs/Circular%20DTAM%20103%20of%202020-%20Launch%20of%20SGX%20FTSE%20Equity%20Index%20Futures.pdf
Its header reads "Circular / 9 November2020 / Circular No. DT/AM – 103 of 2020". So SGX-DT circulars are identified as "Circular No. DT/AM – <n> of <year>", and KGI's file-naming convention is "Circular DTAM <n> of <year>- <Title>.pdf" under https://www.kgieworld.sg/futures/resources/ck/files/docs/ (appendices: "DTAM <n> of <year> Appendix A - ...pdf").

The second verbatim-mirror host is CITIC Futures International (HK), which attaches the SGX PDFs and names them inline, e.g. at https://www.citicsf.com.hk/content/2101/37485 : "更多详情请参阅附件 1. 通告 DTAM 2 of 2026 SGX SICOM Rubber Contracts.pdf 2. 附录 A DTAM 2 of 2026 Appendix A - SICOM TSR 20 Rubber ContractSpecs.pdf". Their attachments are served from https://www.citicsf.com.hk/attachment?aid=<n>&uid=<uuid>.

I enumerated both stores. KGI's docs directory holds only DTAM 103 of 2020 (+ its two appendices) — no 2019 or 2024 circular. CITIC's notice archive (ids 36987..37536, spanning 2016-04-08 to 2026-06) contains no SGX notice for Nov 2019 or Nov 2024. So the DT/AM number for A and B remains unknown; the scheme above is the lead, not the answer.
bracket:
(A) 04:45 -> 05:15 SGT T+1 close — three independent dated broker notices published BEFORE the change all name Monday 11 November 2019, so the change is bracketed 2019-11-08 (last dated artifact stating 04:45 still in force) .. 2019-11-11 (stated effective date):
  - OLD side, 2019-11-06: Rakuten Securities' own "新旧対照表" PDF, revision-stamped （2019年10月）for the old column and （2019年11月）for the new, shows SGX Nikkei 225 T+1 close 翌午前5:45 -> 翌午前6:15 JST (= 04:45 -> 05:15 SGT).
  - OLD side, 2019-11-07: HGNH International Futures table, "香港交易时间（目前）" column 04:45 for UC/FE/CN/NK/TW/IN/SG.
  - OLD side, 2019-11-08: Phillip Futures Pte Ltd (SGX member).
  - NEW side: KGI Securities (Singapore) contract-specifications page, Wayback capture 20201022011223, shows Nikkei 225 "0730 - 1425, 1455 - 0515".
  CAVEAT — the purely archival broker bracket is much looser and slightly misleading: KGI's same page still showed "1455 - 0445" in the 2019-11-14 capture (20191114015650), i.e. the broker page lagged 3 days past the cutover. Archival-only bracket from KGI = 2019-11-14 .. 2020-10-22.

(B) Japan T-session extension — bracketed 2024-07-23 .. 2024-12-17 by archived captures of one dated broker page, and narrowed to Monday 4 November 2024 by two dated pre-change broker notices:
  - OLD side, Wayback 20240723152218 of https://www.rakuten-sec.co.jp/web/foreign_futures/rule/session/ : "SGX Nikkei 225 Index Futures（SGX日経225先物（円建）） SGX 8:30～15:30, 15:55-翌6:15" JST (= T 07:30-14:30, T+1 14:55-05:15 SGT).
  - NEW side, Wayback 20241217011257 of the same URL: "8:30～16:00, 16:25-翌6:15" JST (= T 07:30-15:00, T+1 15:25-05:15 SGT).
  - Rakuten notice dated 2024-10-18 and Phillip Nova notice dated 2024-10-30 both state the SGX side is effective Monday 4 November 2024 (JPX side Tuesday 5 November 2024).
  Note on convention: brokers in this channel state the Nikkei T close as 14:30 SGT, not 14:25. KGI's spec page uses 14:25 ("0730 - 1425, 1455 - ..."), i.e. last-matching vs. end-of-pre-close. The repo's 14:25 -> 14:55 is the same event as the brokers' 14:30 -> 15:00.

(C) BONUS / CORRECTION — the "intermediate step" is NOT between 2018-07-11 and 2019-05-31. The SGX page captured 2018-07-11 is STALE LEGACY CONTENT and cannot serve as a lower bound: capture 20180711020353 of http://www.sgx.com/wps/wcm/connect/mp_en/site/trading_on_sgx/derivatives_market/derivatives_trading_hours_and_calendar/Trading+Hours still lists delisted/renamed products ("MSCI Asia Apex 50", "MSCI Hong Kong+ Index Futures", "S&P CNX Nifty Index Futures", "FTSE Xinhua China A50") and a Nikkei T session of "7.45 am - 2.25 pm" — a pre-2015 snapshot.
  The 02:00 -> 04:45 move actually happened on Monday 14 November 2016, at the SGX Titan DT/DC platform launch. Bracket 2016-07-06 (Wing Fung Futures notice: A50 T+1 "4:40 p.m. – 2:00 a.m.") .. 2016-11-14 (CITIC Futures International notice, verbatim table, all T+1 closes 4:45am), independently corroborated by KGI Securities (Singapore) capture 20180712065739 already showing "1455 - 0445".

1. NO BROKER IN THIS CHANNEL CITES A CIRCULAR NUMBER FOR EITHER TARGET. Checked and confirmed non-citing: Phillip Futures / Phillip Nova (2019, 2024 and 2025 T+1 notices all say only "the Singapore Exchange will be extending..." / "Please visit JPX and SGX websites"), Rakuten Securities (2019 and 2024), HGNH International (2019, says only "根据新交所通知"), Wing Fung Futures (2016).

2. PHILLIP FUTURES "Titan Launch - Key Changes.pdf" — the single most promising pointer for the 2016-11-14 step. Linked from the 16 Nov 2016 announcement as http://www.phillipfutures.com.sg/downloads/data/Titan%20Launch%20-%20Key%20Changes.pdf . Dead live (connection fails on phillipfutures.com.sg; 404 on phillipnova.com.sg), and a CDX sweep of phillipfutures.com.sg/downloads/data/* returned zero captures. The detail pages 412-launch-of-titan... and 415-key-changes-to-sgx-trading-hours... were also never archived (only the index page that quotes them). Worth one more attempt from a different mirror if the parent has one.

3. KGI SECURITIES (SINGAPORE) circular store — enumerated. https://www.kgieworld.sg/futures/resources/ck/files/docs/ holds exactly one SGX circular set (DTAM 103 of 2020 + Appendix A + Appendix B); everything else is account-opening forms, market-data agreements and research PDFs. Crawled the futures landing, announcements, sgx-trading-calendar, contract-specifications, products-exchanges and forms-download pages: 43 unique docs links, no other DTAM file. CDX of that directory: 56 objects, no circulars.

4. CITIC FUTURES INTERNATIONAL notice archive — fully enumerated (ids 36987..37539, 553 live notices, 2016-04-08 through 2026-06). SGX-titled notices are only: 37014 (2016-11-14, the Titan hours change), 37057/37058 (2017-10-06, FEF+UC T-session start only), then nothing until 37328 (2023-07). The Sep-Dec 2019 window contains only 37175-37183 (fraud warning, holiday funding, US/EU DST, statement changes, holiday schedules) — no SGX T+1 notice. Their attachment endpoint is /attachment?aid=<n>&uid=<uuid>; aid=53 (2017) is a mirrored SGX hours PDF, aid=135 is the 2026 DTAM 2 circular.

5. HGNH (henghua.hk) — its bulletin JSON API /jSearch/queryNewsListByMultiTypeForJson.shtm?site=newnanhuahk&types=101,1011,1012,1013 returns only 500 rows starting 2025-03-05. Older PDFs survive under /cmsbigfile/YYYY/MM/<uuid>/<name>.pdf but the UUID path segment makes the store non-enumerable; the 2019 file was only reachable because a search engine had indexed it.

6. PHILLIP NOVA announcement archive (WP REST, post type "announcement") — 132 posts, oldest 2020-12-18. Contains no 2019 content; the 2019 Phillip material survives only on the retired phillipfutures.com.sg domain via Wayback.

7. RAKUTEN SECURITIES notice archive — crawled all 660 notice pages for 2017-2019 from their sitemap and all 481 for 2024-2025. For 2017-2019 there is exactly ONE SGX trading-hours notice (info20191106-01). There is NO Rakuten notice for a 02:00->04:45 change, consistent with that change predating 2017. Their archives.html?year=YYYY listing is JS-driven and returns no rows to curl; the sitemap is the way in.

8. ORIENT FUTURES SINGAPORE (SGX member) — WP REST search for "DTAM", "circular", "T+1", "trading hours" returns only marketing/research content. No circular mirrors, no market-notice archive.

9. MoneyDJ Taiwanese forum thread 181611 ("新加坡期貨交易所 延長T+1盤收盤時間自05:15，自2019年11月11日開始", dated 2019-11-01 per search snippet) returns HTTP 500 live and has zero Wayback captures. Unrecoverable, and a forum post anyway.

10. res.wfgold.com — directory listing and the wfgold.com site are behind Cloudflare (403); only direct known PDF paths resolve. Guessed filenames for a T+1 notice all 404.

11. cnzsqh.hk (浙商国际) view.php?id=N — CMS only goes back to ~2023 despite id 1368 being current; ids 100-900 map to 2023-2024 re-publications. No 2019 content.

12. INTERACTIVE BROKERS — no usable exchange-notice archive surfaced for SGX 2019/2024 through search or CDX; their contract/trading-hours data is JS-driven and not archived in a form that states SGX T+1 times.

13. IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY WARNINGS FOR THE PARENT:
   (a) The 2018-07-11 SGX Trading Hours capture is stale legacy content (pre-2015 product names and hours) — it must not be used as the lower bound for the 02:00 close. See bracket (C).
   (b) Broker pages lag cutovers. KGI Securities (Singapore) still published 04:45 on 2019-11-14, three days after the change. Any bracket built purely from archived broker spec pages will be too late on the "new hours" side.
   (c) Brokers disagree on the Nikkei T close by five minutes (14:25 on KGI, 14:30 on Phillip/CITIC/Rakuten) because some quote last-matching and others end-of-pre-close. Do not treat that as a separate revision.

14. Internet Archive was intermittently returning "Internet Archive: Temporarily Offline" HTML for both CDX and playback throughout this session; all CDX/playback calls here were wrapped in a retry loop that rejects those pages, so the negative CDX results above are real absences, not outages.
